verdict.summary: The read-only verification path correctly reconciles planned beads against unambiguous issue mappings, detects duplicate mappings and missing dependency/parent markers, treats unresolved endpoints fail-closed through the corresponding duplicate/unmigrated conditions, and returns a failing exit status for live gaps. The tests exercise complete, interrupted, wrong-target, wrong-kind, duplicate, unmigrated, closed-endpoint, native-summary, report-rendering, and parser-sync cases on the real verification functions. The CLI rejects conflicting write/read modes and short-circuits verification before all mutation paths. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect requiring changes was found.
